title: IR Remote Control System
description: Build an IR remote control system using an IR receiver module and LED. The LED toggles ON/OFF whenever a button on the IR remote is pressed.
objectives: Receive infrared signals from an IR remote using the IR receiver module
Decode remote control button presses using the IRremote library
Control an LED connected to pin D13
Toggle the LED state when an IR signal is received
Understand wireless infrared communication and remote control interfacing
